mentions.name: Yarnt
mentions.description: A task tracker that is actively hostile towards you having tasks. Started as a joke but genuinely used for tracking one's own work; pitched at people whose managers keep assigning them work. Free until the Stripe integration ships.
mentions.problem: Task overload from managers who like assigning work.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://getyarnt.com (Free until I ship the Stripe integration) - A task tracker that's actively hostile towards you having tasks. Started as a joke, but I'm using it to track my own stuff and really enjoying it. If you have a manager who likes assigning you work, tell them to get Yarnt!
mentions.author: kristjan
